description.value: Elisa is a Michelin Guide-recommended wood-fired grill in Vancouver's Yaletown neighborhood, celebrated for its fine steaks and seafood. Ranked among the 101 Best Steak Restaurants in the World and named Vancouver Magazine's Restaurant of the Year, it features both indoor and outdoor seating with a full bar. The restaurant also operates Luigi & Sons Butcher Shop as a companion venture.
